signatureMotifs.acousticWand: Right-hand raised glowing cyan-emerald stylus (#48f0c8) — acts as the origin of the diagonal decryption ray when extracting a 3D song cassette, and can serve as the playback progress laser pointer.
signatureMotifs.goldenSoundwaveGlyphs: Bottom-right vertical hand-drawn golden barcode/waveform strokes from E2 art — replicated as the live audio spectrum visualizer inside the Master Playback Pill and 3D cassette edge.
signatureMotifs.mechanicalTrussRibs: Black articulated micro-cranes and floating glass plates orbiting Nasti — integrated into the 6-part 360° cassette disassembly viewer.
signatureMotifs.diamondPrismFrame: 45-degree rotated architectural diamond frame — used as the signature container mask for the E2 Atelier companion view and boot sequence reveal.
